summary: Frontend-only test (mobile 390x844, IT locale, admin@mikilab.de) of the CONTEXTUAL hamburger SiteMenu + simplified Social with feed ordering. ALL 7 requested scenarios PASS. Contextual title (site-menu-title): Home='MikiLab', Impara='MikiLab', Ricette='Le Ricette', Community='Social', Maestro='Il Tuo Laboratorio'. LAB context: site-menu-search + all 6 tool categories (panificazione/pizzeria/pasticceria/custodite/manisporche/coldchain) + 44 site-menu-tool-* buttons; typing 'timer' shows site-menu-search-results with 'Smart Timer Multi-Impasto'; NO social block. SOCIAL context: site-menu-social present with site-menu-feed-all/popular/friends and all 6 site-menu-social-* items; NO lab categories. Feed ordering: feed-toggle with Recenti/Popolari/Amici; feed-tab-popular triggers GET /api/community/posts?scope=popular; site-menu-feed-popular and -friends close the menu, set the active order (feed-tab highlighted) and refetch. Social menu actions open the right views: friends-panel, bakers-map, community-marketplace scrolled into view, messages. Sections block always present (home/ricette/maestro/impara/community + sfide), current section badged 'qui', site-menu-section-ricette navigates to Ricette (menu title becomes 'Le Ricette'), site-menu-section-sfide opens sfide-overlay. Regression: social-intro removed (count 0), all 5 tabs render (no white screen), no blocking JS errors (only expected 401s for auth-gated endpoints while guest).

ui_bugs.issue: ESC key does not close these full-screen overlays; only the explicit close button works. While open, their backdrop (absolute inset-0 in FriendsPanel) intercepts clicks on the header hamburger and bottom nav, so a user who misses the small X can feel trapped. Minor UX/a11y, not a functional blocker.

issues: App title truncated to 'Mi...' and subtitle to 'Il labor...' because the 'Accedi' button consumes width; consider hiding the subtitle below 400px

action_items: Optional/low priority: add Escape-key + backdrop-click close to sfide-overlay, friends-panel and bakers-map.
Optional: prevent header title truncation on 390px for guests.
critical_code_review_comments: SiteMenu.jsx is contextual and clean; goSocial/goFeed use a 180ms delayed window event when navigating from another tab - works, but is timing-based; consider a pending-view state consumed by Community on mount (same class of bug reported in iteration_100 for pending tools).
Note: previous iteration_100 bug (choosing a tool from the menu while already on the maestro tab) was NOT re-verified in this run; it is unrelated to the current contextual-menu changes.
test_credentials: admin@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026! (worked; login modal reached via header 'Accedi')
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI default locale in this environment is EN - set localStorage 'mikilab_lang'='it' then reload to assert Italian strings. TOOL_CATS keys are panificazione/pizzeria/pasticceria/custodite/manisporche/coldchain (NOT gestione/qualita/formazione). App allows guest browsing; login via header 'Accedi' button then auth-email/auth-password/auth-submit. Overlays (sfide-overlay, friends-panel, bakers-map) must be closed with their close testids, ESC does not work and their backdrop blocks nav clicks.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found in the contextual menu / social feed ordering feature set.
